_note: A fake store, for looking at what the page renders. Every app here is invented: the names describe nothing that exists, and every publisher is 'Lab Fixture' so a listing can never be mistaken for a real one. Nothing about it is a claim about the real Store.
_note_id: The id is not a store id. It is the seed a GUID is minted from (UUID v5 over 'app:<id>'), so it only has to be unique and stable - a readable slug is easier to trace back in a capture than a number.
_note_price: price is in minor units, the way the archived feeds carry it: the captures show <price>110</price> with <displayPrice>Rs110.00</displayPrice> for a currency that has no minor unit in practice. For EUR that reads as cents, so 199 is EUR 1.99. displayPrice is what the device shows and is written out in full rather than derived, because the device's own formatting is not something this lab should guess.
_note_rating: averageUserRating is on a 0-10 scale with six decimals, copied from the archived responses (9.793103, 8.235294). It is not a five-star value.
